scope: BCM2712 FDT SD power/cleanup ownership and standalone module inclusion; no physical SD operation or all-Pi qualification.

validation.native_build: Original sdhci_fdt Makefile with BCM2712 source and generated headers included, -Werror, FDT/INTRNG, no install/load.
validation.production_callbacks: Clang18/GCC ASan+UBSan: supply acquisition/rollback/restore, bounded reset and interrupt-disable readback, every fallible cleanup operation and retry, valid child-busy refusal, retained DMA/GPIO/regulator/clock owners on reset or provider failures, I/O supply rollback failure cannot drop newly-enabled card supply.
validation.existing_sd_controls: Pi5 pinctrl/regulator provider and Pi4 ACPI SD Clang18 controls pass.

limitations: No physical SD command/read/write, insertion/removal, electrical timing, UHS/1.8V or full-RAM DMA acceptance.
Existing selected SD bootstrap is3.3V/up to50MHz and refuses MMCCAM power lifecycle.
D0 pinctrl/AON GPIO provider scope does not establish C1 or unidentified CM5/Pi500 carrier qualification.
Reset completion and safe owner retention are tested against mocks; physical controller behavior remains unverified.
